objective: Fix Android Community Wall author identity density: show one-line member name, same-line date and time, and genuine stored profile photos even when a member is unverified or profile locked, while preserving locked private details.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Live Supabase BUKLOD Connect project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu API RPC readback and runtime auth simulation on 2026-11-16: existing screenshot user with saved photo previously excluded because is_verified=false; signed-in RPC after migration returns one existing photo for that member and one locked-profile member, with anon EXECUTE denied and private member details unchanged. Main repository baseline SHA 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 was inspected, but main is NOT assumed identical to published production Android OTA. Frontend is DEV-only pending exact staging RC and Android production verification.
chosenApproach: Remove unrelated is_verified check only from authenticated active-account avatar-only RPC; preserve existing private profile-detail lock. Put Follow/overflow under two-line metadata rather than steal author-name/date width; use compact Manila-local date/time.
selectionRationale: Existing storage already has photos and bucket is public; fixing the 2-field avatar RPC avoids guessing invalid paths or broadening profiles RLS. Header layout isolation protects complex Wall/media/feed/AdMob behavior.
alternativeApproaches: Require manual verification to see photos (rejected because valid community avatar identity should not depend on verification)
Read full locked profiles or widen RLS (rejected privacy regression)
Shrink all author names to tiny font (rejected accessibility issue)
preserveBehaviors: Profile lock remains authoritative for member details; avatar URL is the only newly visible field
Maintain existing post delete/edit/report, following, Connect note, profile tap and Community media
Preserve AdMob insertion, Wall scroll visibility, Android runtime 1.3.2 and tab/navigation performance
Do not publish web/production OTA or change app native dependencies from this branch
acceptanceChecks: Single-line Wall author name; date and time on one line at Android screenshot viewport
RPC exposes valid existing photo for unverified member and locked private member in authenticated session, while anon EXECUTE denied
SQL schema/regression tests and scoped Node navigation/media tests pass
Exact staging Android RC, runtime parity and OTA manifest readback required before production claim
